slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint on the total amount that can be invested across all products in a single year, or is the only limit the cash available at the beginning of that year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether the only limit is cash available at the beginning of the year, which touches the cash-only funding issue, but did not explicitly ask whether borrowing or negative cash balances are allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No borrowing is allowed and investments must be funded only by currently available cash.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether borrowing or negative cash balances were permitted; it only asked about per-year investment limits and then assumed cash-only funding in the READY_TO_MODEL constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 no-borrowing/cash-only funding slot was not fully resolved; it was only partially touched and then silently assumed.

summary: The agent clarified many product and cash-flow details but only partially addressed the no-borrowing/cash-only funding rule, then silently assumed it in the final model. This leaves a P1 hidden slot unresolved at stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
